facets.name: Shadow Gaze
facets.description: The Ithaeur's gaze exposes the symbolic truth hidden in a spirit.
facets.effect: Add Wisdom Renown to Empathy rolls when interacting with spirits and the Ridden. The Ithaeur may also read a spirit she can perceive; the second and later readings in the same scene each cost another Essence.
facets.dramaticFailure: The spirit cannot be read and becomes aware of the attempt.
facets.success: Learn the spirit's ban or bane.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Learn both the spirit's ban and bane.

facets.name: Spirit Whispers
facets.description: A whispered question stirs the secrets of a sleeping spirit.
facets.effect: Address one perceived object or dormant spirit that can hear the Ithaeur. Ask a simple question no longer than one sentence about its immediate surroundings or sphere of influence.
facets.dramaticFailure: The spirit gives a false or misleading answer.
facets.failure: The spirit remains dormant and gives no answer.
facets.success: The spirit whispers a one-sentence answer based only on its immediate surroundings or influence. It may know an entry code or recent visitors to a door, for example. An answer that it does not know is valid.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The answer can be longer than one sentence.

facets.name: Shadow Hunter
facets.description: The Ithaeur leads the Sacred Hunt through the Shadow.
facets.activationRequirement: Activate only when gaining the Siskur-Dah Condition.
facets.effect: While in the Shadow and pursuing the Siskur-Dah's prey, add Wisdom Renown to Perception rolls, rolls to resist spirit Numina and Dread Powers, and rolls to travel or chase through the Shadow.

facets.name: Shadow Masquerade
facets.description: The Ithaeur wears a spirit's Essence as a disguise among the denizens of Shadow.
facets.effect: Choose one spirit the Ithaeur can perceive.
facets.dramaticFailure: The disguise fails. Gain the Ban Condition matching the target spirit's own ban.
facets.success: Copy Influence dots equal to successes and take either the spirit's ban or its bane. Use the Shadow Masquerade dice pool for the copied Influences. Other spirits perceive the Ithaeur as the target's type of spirit while she acts appropriately. Suspicious behavior permits Finesse + Resistance − the copied spirit's Rank to pierce the disguise; success immediately ends this Facet.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Attempts by spirits to pierce the disguise also subtract the Ithaeur's Wisdom Renown.

facets.name: Panopticon
facets.description: The Ithaeur binds nearby spirits into a network of borrowed senses.
facets.cost: Essence equal to the maximum spirit Rank affected
facets.duration: 1 scene; extend for 1 additional Essence per scene
facets.failure: Accumulate no successes and gain Stumbled.
facets.success: Accumulate successes. At the target, become aware of every spirit up to the chosen Rank within Wisdom Renown × 100 yards and suffer −3 to the Ithaeur's own Perception for the duration. Gain a rough sense of their perceptions and whether they are injured or fighting. An instant action focuses fully on one spirit's senses or withdraws from them; focusing blocks the Ithaeur's own senses and the other spirits' input, but conveys that spirit's perceptions with perfect clarity. Spend one Essence to penalize all individual Perception rolls that spirit makes for one scene by Wisdom Renown.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The Facet imposes no penalty on the Ithaeur's Perception.

facets.name: Killer Instinct
facets.description: The Rahu brings killing instincts to the forefront.
facets.effect: Apply 8-again to Brawl and Weaponry dice pools for the scene.

facets.name: Warrior's Hide
facets.description: The Rahu's body endures the punishment of battle.
facets.effect: Permanently add Purity Renown to Health. Each additional Purity dot increases this bonus by one.

facets.name: Bloody-Handed Hunter
facets.description: The Rahu sweeps aside anything obstructing the Sacred Hunt.
facets.activationRequirement: Activate only when gaining the Siskur-Dah Condition.
facets.effect: Add Purity Renown to attack rolls against anyone obstructing pursuit of the Siskur-Dah's prey, including hostile allies or a human bureaucrat. Do not apply this bonus against the Hunt's prey itself.

facets.name: Butchery
facets.description: The Rahu turns fighting many opponents into an opportunity for slaughter.
facets.dramaticFailure: Defense becomes 0 for one turn. During that turn the Rahu cannot take an action requiring him to give up Defense.
facets.success: While fighting more than one enemy, whenever the Rahu hits a foe unarmed (including teeth and claws) or is hit by a foe, he may apply one of the listed Tilts to that foe even if no damage was dealt. Killing or incapacitating an enemy extends the duration by one turn.
facets.options: Arm Wrack; Blinded; Deafened; Knocked Down; Leg Wrack.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Apply three listed Tilts to the first enemy who strikes or is struck by the Rahu after activation.

facets.name: Crimson Spasm
facets.description: Raw lunar fury twists the Rahu's body into a primal engine of destruction.
facets.dramaticFailure: Suffer a breaking point toward Spirit and involuntarily change to another form.
facets.success: Each success grants a choice from the listed benefits, which stack with other Facets and forms. Maintain the Spasm by spending one Essence each turn. In Hishu or Urhan, cause Lunacy as if in Dalu.
facets.options: For each success: add two Strength dots; add two Stamina dots; add one general armor; or add +1 lethal damage to natural weapons.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Also regenerate one lethal damage for free every turn the Spasm is maintained.

facets.name: War Howl
facets.description: The Cahalith's howl drives her pack into a killing fury.
facets.dramaticFailure: One enemy who hears the howl regains one spent Willpower point.
facets.failure: The howl does not inspire the pack.
facets.success: All members of the Cahalith's pack within earshot gain +1L to Brawl and Weaponry attacks for the duration. This extra damage is lethal even when the attack otherwise deals bashing damage.

facets.name: Voice of Glory
facets.description: The Cahalith's voice enthralls allies and unsuspecting prey alike.
facets.effect: Add Glory Renown to Expression and Persuasion dice pools. When meeting someone for the first time, improve the first impression by one step. Improve it by another step when inspiring or inciting aggression or violence.

facets.name: Dream Hunter
facets.description: The Cahalith tracks her prey into the shelter of dreams.
facets.activationRequirement: Activate only when gaining the Siskur-Dah Condition.
facets.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Glory vs Composure + Primal Urge (to invade the prey's dreams)
facets.effect: Know immediately when the Hunt's prey enters deep, dreaming sleep. Fall asleep naturally, meditate to sleep, or spend one additional Essence to fall asleep immediately; then attempt to enter the prey's dreams.
facets.dramaticFailure: Become lost in alien dreams and gain Exhausted on waking.
facets.failure: Fail to find the prey's dreams and wake. Another attempt is impossible until the prey wakes and falls asleep again.
facets.success: Enter the prey's subconscious as a frightening wolf that the prey remembers on waking. Choose one of the listed effects.
facets.options: Force the prey awake with nightmares: no Willpower recovery from resting and gain Exhausted. Or induce Paranoid on waking. Or grant Open, making the prey accessible to spirits. Or learn one detail: approximate physical location; Blood and Bone (or Virtue and Vice or equivalent anchors); precautions against the Hunt; or an impression of the immediate surroundings.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The Cahalith regains one spent Willpower point on waking.

facets.name: Thousand-Throat Howl
facets.description: A thousand voices join the Cahalith's howl to scatter her prey's resolve.
facets.dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Glory vs Resolve + Primal Urge
facets.success: Prey who hear the howl and roll fewer successes than the Cahalith gain Demoralized.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Every prey affected by Demoralized also loses one Willpower point.

facets.name: End of Story
facets.description: The Cahalith recounts the brutal ending that awaits her prey.
facets.dicePool: Presence + Persuasion + Glory vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Name the prey while relating its impending fate to packmates.
facets.dramaticFailure: For one day, the Cahalith subtracts her Glory Renown from Defense against the prey.
facets.success: When fleeing or hiding from the Cahalith or her packmates, the prey subtracts Glory Renown from Speed, chase rolls, and Stealth. In combat with the Cahalith, subtract the same amount from Initiative and Defense against her attacks. The first time each scene that the prey damages the Cahalith or a packmate, reduce that damage by Glory Renown.

facets.name: Scent Beneath the Surface
facets.description: The Elodoth's senses separate truth from deception.
facets.dicePool: Wits + Empathy + Honor vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Observe or converse with the target for at least one turn.
facets.dramaticFailure: The Elodoth believes everything the prey says.
facets.success: Discern whether the prey's words and actions are truthful or deceptive, including outright lies, omissions, and attempts to mislead or dissemble.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Add Honor Renown to all Manipulation-based dice pools targeting the prey for the rest of the scene.

facets.name: Binding Oath
facets.description: The Elodoth binds an agreement into the world's network of obligations.
facets.dicePool: Resolve + Persuasion + Honor vs Resolve + Primal Urge
facets.effect: Bind an agreement between two parties, either as a participant or as its overseer. The parties seal it with a symbolic act such as signing or a blood handshake. The agreement is usually voluntary; a party tricked into it resists subconsciously.
facets.dramaticFailure: The oath does not bind; the first party to break it regains two spent Willpower points.
facets.failure: Neither party is bound by the Facet.
facets.success: Actions that would break the oath, even unknowingly, suffer a penalty equal to Honor Renown as circumstances conspire against the oathbreaker.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The Elodoth immediately knows when the oath is broken and which party broke it.

facets.name: Sly Hunter
facets.description: The Elodoth catches prey in a web of favors and connections.
facets.activationRequirement: Activate only when gaining the Siskur-Dah Condition.
facets.effect: While pursuing the Hunt's prey, add Honor Renown to actions using the Elodoth's Allies or Contacts to locate or obstruct the prey, and to Social rolls attacking or hampering the prey's Allies, Alternate Identity, Contacts, Resources, or Status Merits.

facets.name: Ties of Word and Promise
facets.description: Promises and assurances briefly establish useful ties to an organization.
facets.cost: 1 Essence per dot of the desired Merit
facets.activationRequirement: The Elodoth or existing Allies and Contacts must have a friendly connection to the group. Contact at least one member of that group. An explicitly hostile group imposes −3 to the roll.
facets.options: Allies; Alternate Identity; Contacts; Resources; Status.
facets.dramaticFailure: The group rebuffs the Elodoth and tries to obstruct an existing Allies or Contacts Merit.
facets.failure: Accumulate no successes and gain Stumbled.
facets.success: Accumulate successes. At the target, gain the desired Merit at the purchased rating for one day.

facets.name: Ties of Blood and Bone
facets.description: The Elodoth draws on the bonds of flesh and bone to exchange places with a packmate.
facets.dicePool: Stamina + Empathy + Honor vs Stamina + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Choose one packmate within Honor Renown in miles. A target outside this range makes the Facet fail; an unwilling packmate may resist with Stamina + Primal Urge.
facets.dramaticFailure: The Facet fails and the Elodoth suffers Arm Wrack or Leg Wrack.
facets.success: The Elodoth and packmate exchange physical locations, each retaining their own clothing and carried equipment. The Facet does not reveal the packmate's condition or surroundings before the exchange.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Both participants also heal two points of lethal or bashing damage during the exchange.

facets.name: Eviscerate
facets.description: The Irraka turns an unsuspected first strike into a devastating attack.
facets.effect: Activate as part of a Brawl or Weaponry attack against an unaware or surprised opponent. Treat that attack as a rote action.

facets.name: Slip Away
facets.description: The Irraka blurs the memories of anyone who witnesses her passing.
facets.effect: Witnesses dismiss memories of the Irraka when she does nothing memorable toward them. If she fights, asks strange questions, acts suspiciously, or someone prompts a witness to examine their memories, subtract Cunning Renown from rolls to remember her, even with otherwise perfect memory. This obscures details of the Irraka, not the fact that a memorable event happened.

facets.name: Relentless Hunter
facets.description: The Irraka finds a route through every defense surrounding the prey.
facets.activationRequirement: Activate only when gaining the Siskur-Dah Condition.
facets.effect: While pursuing the Hunt's prey, add Cunning Renown to Stealth against the prey, rolls overcoming the prey's security or obstructions, and rolls identifying entrances, alternative routes, or other ways to reach the prey's hiding place.

facets.name: Divide and Conquer
facets.description: A subtle distraction draws the Irraka's prey away from the safety of its group.
facets.dicePool: Manipulation + Subterfuge + Cunning vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Choose a visible individual in a group and supply a distraction of sound or movement. It can be tiny and initially noticed only by the target.
facets.dramaticFailure: The prey gains Spooked and clings desperately to the group.
facets.success: The prey gains Lured and willingly leaves the group's immediate presence to investigate, despite better judgment.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Also inflict Lured on additional group members equal to Cunning Renown, scattering them after illusory distractions.

facets.name: Breach
facets.description: The Irraka slips through the Gauntlet between Flesh and Shadow.
facets.dramaticFailure: The player chooses Arm Wrack, Leg Wrack, or Stunned for the Irraka.
facets.failure: The Irraka cannot cross the Gauntlet.
facets.success: Cross immediately to the corresponding location in Flesh or Shadow, without needing a locus.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The next use of Breach this scene costs no Essence.
